activation.rumoca-ir-solve: The hidden parameter that reads 1 while this clock ticks.

activation_parameter_indices.rumoca-ir-solve: Hidden Boolean-as-Real P slot for each typed periodic clock. The runtime derives each value from the schedule at the current event instant. These lanes make clock leaves computable inside mixed condition DAGs without creating another clock or row owner.

active_discrete_scalar_count.rumoca-ir-dae: DAE-owned derived metric: discrete coordinate scalars referenced by the finalized checked expression graph.

active_fold.rumoca-ir-dae: Lexically innermost open loop, or `None` at the function's top level. Every definition insertion reads this one field, so the issuing scope is recorded by the same act that issues the definition identity.

affine.rumoca-phase-structural: Classes proven equal up to sign and a time-invariant displacement. Members share a derivative but not necessarily a value.

algebraic_dependent.rumoca-ir-solve: Whether the relation memory is refreshed from the algebraic coordinate after the event commit.

aliases.rumoca-phase-structural: The STRUCT-T02 alias quotient applied before this analysis, including every class it left unchanged and why.

alternate_charts.rumoca-ir-solve: Additional admissible reconstruction charts for this block. Each chart re-partitions the block's `y_indices` into dependent (reconstructed) and independent (integrated) coordinates over the same `manifold_residual` rows; `tearing` remains the primary chart. A definitional first-integral manifold has no globally regular reduced chart, so a fixed partition folds when a dependent coordinate passes through zero. This bounded set of coordinate patches lets a runtime re-select a regular chart across such a fold. Empty for every single-chart block. An empty set is omitted from human-readable serialization by the manual [`Serialize`] below, so a single-chart block's JSON is byte-identical to a block that predates the field; positional binary formats keep the field so their fixed layout still round-trips.

anchor.rumoca-phase-structural: Anchor of the class rooted at each variable ordinal.

anchor_parity.rumoca-phase-structural: Sign of the member that supplied an invariant anchor relative to its class root. Derivative readers deliberately ignore this sign because both signs differentiate to zero; value readers must retain it.

annotation.rumoca-ir-ast: Annotation arguments attached to the external clause (MLS §12.9.4). These remain syntax-preserving AST expressions so annotations such as `Library` and `Include` are not collapsed into rendered strings. The field is always written: the parsed-artifact cache decodes this type positionally, so no field may be omitted by value.

args.rumoca-ir-ast: Arguments passed to the external function.

array_component_declarations.rumoca-ir-ast: Declarations with at least one array occurrence, including empty arrays that produce no component instances. This only vetoes universal scalar proofs; it does not identify or merge runtime occurrences.

array_parent_dims.rumoca-ir-ast: Array parent dimensions for expanded array components. When an array component like `plug_p.pin[3]` is expanded to indexed instances (`plug_p.pin[1]`, `plug_p.pin[2]`, `plug_p.pin[3]`), this map stores the parent path `plug_p.pin` with dimensions `[3]` for use in array equation expansion.

array_subscripts.rumoca-ir-ast: Array subscripts for type alias definitions (e.g., `type Vector3 = Real[3]`) Stores the `[3]` part as subscripts for later use in type resolution

artifacts.rumoca-ir-solve: Runtime-executable continuous solver artifacts of the alternate basis: its AD Jacobian-vector products and derived structural patterns. Derived data, rebuilt after decode by the owning phase, so it is skipped by every serializer and defaults to empty until re-materialized.

assert_equations.rumoca-ir-flat: Runtime assertion equations from regular equation sections (MLS §8.3.7). Assertions are preserved for flat output but do not contribute to DAE equation balance/unknown counts.

assertion_projection.rumoca-ir-solve: Wire recipe for the checked projection of one source invocation. A detached recipe grants no authority; the observer borrows its exact model table, source program and ordered action inventory together.

assignment_leaf_dependencies.rumoca-ir-solve: Issued once every program exists; see [`LeafDependencies`].

at_root.rumoca-phase-structural: The value the pin states for the class root.

attribute_source_scopes.rumoca-ir-ast: Lexical scopes where attribute modifiers were written, keyed by attribute name (`start`, `min`, `max`, `nominal`).

avoided.rumoca-phase-structural: `StateSelect.avoid` or `never`: a state the model prefers not to keep.

baked_starts.rumoca-ir-solve: Selected parameter to the states whose `start` expression reads it and that the initialization neither solves nor updates: the lowered model fixed those starts as constants.

base.rumoca-ir-ast: The expression to access the field from.

base_def_id.rumoca-ir-ast: Resolved reference to the base class definition. None when first parsed, populated during name resolution.

base_matching.rumoca-phase-structural: A maximum matching of the base rows, built on the first bound.

base_partition_index.rumoca-ir-flat: Dense-position lookup for globally unique base-clock IDs.

base_partitions.rumoca-ir-flat: Base-clock partitions (execute asynchronously from each other).

binding.rumoca-ir-ast: The binding expression from `= expr` in declaration (e.g., `Real v = p.v - n.v`) Separate from `start` to preserve binding when both binding and start modifier are present.

binding_execution.rumoca-ir-solve: Whole-program evaluation and lifecycle-specific commits share one owner.

binding_from_modification.rumoca-ir-ast: True if binding came from a modification rather than declaration.
binding_from_modification.rumoca-ir-flat: True if binding came from a modification rather than declaration.

binding_source.rumoca-ir-ast: Symbolic binding before evaluation for structural queries. Declarations and modifications retain their binding equation here when instantiation resolves a different value into `binding`. Flattening uses this source to preserve dependencies on changeable parent parameters.

binding_source_scope.rumoca-ir-ast: Lexical scope where a modification-derived binding was written. Used during flattening to qualify symbolic modifier references according to MLS §7.2.4 without path-depth heuristics.

block_instance.rumoca-ir-ast: Reference to the block instance for this state.

block_states.rumoca-ir-solve: The states each projection block's unknowns depend on.

blocked.rumoca-phase-structural: Only ever set when `step` is `None`: a stated initial value that the only demotions left would have discarded. That refusal is the reason the system stops reducing here, so it is what the phase reports rather than the singularity it hides behind.

branches.rumoca-ir-ast: List of (condition, expression) pairs for if and elseif branches
branches.rumoca-ir-flat: Branches from Connections.branch(a, b) calls (MLS §9.4). Required edges in the virtual connection graph.

break_names.rumoca-ir-ast: Component names that are deselected via `break` (MLS §7.4 Selective Model Extension). e.g., extends Base(break x, break y) would have break_names = ["x", "y"]

by_name.rumoca-ir-ast: Map from type names to TypeIds for quick lookup.

by_target.rumoca-ir-solve: Every exact assignment target, sorted, with the assignments issuing it.

by_variable.rumoca-phase-structural: Residual ordinals by the variables their walks compared against.

callee_provenance.rumoca-ir-solve: Source span of the callee's call occurrence.

causal_sequence.rumoca-phase-structural: Causal solve order: `(equation, variable)` pairs solved in sequence once the tear variables are known.

causal_so_far.rumoca-phase-structural: Equations solved causally so far in this pass, as `(equation, variable)`.

causal_steps.rumoca-ir-solve: Back-substitution steps evaluated in order once the tear variables are fixed: each step solves its residual row for its unknown.

causality.rumoca-ir-ast: Causality from type alias definition (e.g., `connector RealInput = input Real`) Components of this type inherit this causality
causality.rumoca-ir-dae: FMI-style causality metadata for downstream JSON consumers: one of `Input`, `Output`, `Parameter`, `CalculatedParameter`, `Independent` or `Local`, matching the values of FMI's `causality` attribute. This is the **exported** classification, not the source `input`/`output` prefix — see `declared_causality` for that, which an exported `Input` or `Output` must agree with (SPEC_0040 DAE-C24).

charts.rumoca-phase-structural: Admissible reduced state-selection charts for a folding definitional first-integral coordinate group, naming scalars of `view`. Empty for every prepared system without such a group.

class_def_id.rumoca-ir-ast: DefId of the class definition this instance was instantiated from.

class_kind.rumoca-ir-ast: Specialized class kind (model, record, connector, function, etc.).

class_overrides.rumoca-ir-ast: Active replaceable class/package redeclare overrides for this component instance. Keys are the DefIds of the redeclared local classes (e.g., `Medium`). Values retain the source alias text, effective target DefId, and the redeclare value component reference. Populated during instantiation so downstream phases can apply instance-specific package/class constants consistently (MLS §7.3).

class_type.rumoca-ir-ast: MLS §4.7: The class type of the root model (model, connector, record, etc.)
class_type.rumoca-ir-flat: The class type of the root model (model, connector, record, etc.)

class_type_token.rumoca-ir-ast: Token for the class type keyword (model, class, function, etc.)

classes.rumoca-ir-ast: Nested class definitions (functions, models, packages, etc.)

clock.rumoca-ir-flat: The base clock for this partition.

clock_domains.rumoca-phase-structural: Canonical periodic-clock domains on which this producer can execute. Same-tick exchange exists only between producers whose domains can fire on one shared instant under the caller's [`ClockCoincidence`] relation (identical domains always do); a never-coincident read observes held entry storage.

clock_owner.rumoca-ir-solve: Exact periodic owner for a clock-scoped action. `None` denotes an ordinary state/event action. A clock-owned action is eligible only when this schedule ticks; the condition program retains its activation lane as a local semantic guard.

clock_owners.rumoca-ir-solve: Periodic activation owner for each discrete row. `None` denotes an ordinary event-iteration row. A clock-owned row is evaluated only when the referenced exact lattice ticks.

clock_partition_intermediate_clocks.rumoca-ir-solve: Exact consumer clock domains for each intermediate output row. A row is refreshed iff at least one domain in its non-empty set ticks. The structural same-tick proof issues these sets; execution only replays them and never reconstructs dependency liveness.

clock_partition_intermediate_targets.rumoca-ir-solve: Work-state storage slot for each `clock_partition_intermediates` output row (row-aligned).

clock_partition_intermediates.rumoca-ir-solve: Exact causal definitions of the algebraic intermediates that sit on a same-tick path between two ordered producers (for example an alias chain `slow = fastAlias; fastAlias = fast`). Each output row refreshes one scalar coordinate into private work state only — intermediates become visible to later producers without committing unrelated targets.

clock_partition_order.rumoca-ir-solve: SPEC_0040 SOLVE-C57 (implementing toward SPEC_0046 SDO-001/SDO-002): the construction-issued same-tick execution order for every clock-owned discrete producer. Rank is the vector position — an issued value. The runtime executes the steps in this order against private work state so an ordinary same-instant read observes this tick's value while `pre`/`previous`/ `sample(u)` reads keep their history lanes; the complete final target tuple still commits atomically after the last step. Equation-shaped producers owned by a DAE-C21/SOLVE-C55 event transaction are excluded; the complete transaction replaces them as one opaque outer-producer step. A runtime must never reconstruct this order from targets, names, spans, provenance, or program shape.

clock_schedule.rumoca-ir-solve: Owning periodic clock for MLS §16 `previous()` history. `None` denotes ordinary Modelica `pre()` history and is committed after every event. A scheduled binding is committed only when this clock ticks, so unrelated roots and other clocks cannot advance its history.

clocks.rumoca-ir-solve: The periodic clocks, in clock-owner order.

closed.rumoca-ir-solve: Values of segments closed at the cap.

coefficient.rumoca-ir-solve: Why the step's isolated coefficient is bounded away from zero; set by construction and trusted by every executor (SPEC_0043 §4).

coincident_pairs.rumoca-phase-structural: Cross-identity pairs proved coincident, stored as `(low, high)`.

column_rows.rumoca-ir-solve: The immutable pattern's rows per column, derived only when a consumer needs the coordinate view. Clone keeps the established owned-cache behavior: an initialized view is copied; an unused view stays unused.

compact.rumoca-ir-solve: The compact storage order of the block pattern every placement addresses.

component_ref.rumoca-ir-ast: Structured resolved component reference for this concrete instance. This is the semantic carrier for downstream Flat/DAE phases. The rendered `qualified_name` remains useful for stable output spelling, but compiler logic should prefer this structured reference when available.
component_ref.rumoca-ir-flat: Structured component reference that produced this flattened variable. The rendered flat name is display/protocol data. Compiler logic that needs path structure or resolved identity should use this reference instead of reparsing `name`.

components.rumoca-ir-ast: Instance data for components, keyed by their InstanceId.

composed.rumoca-ir-solve: Composed coordinates per (access, source), `None` when whole.

condition.rumoca-ir-ast: Conditional component expression (e.g., `if use_reset` in `BooleanInput reset if use_reset`) None means the component is unconditional (always present)

condition_memories.rumoca-ir-solve: The parameters actions read at their event-entry value.

condition_memory_parameter_indices.rumoca-ir-solve: Hidden P slots that retain the previous value of each DAE condition. Event-action programs read these slots to distinguish a rising edge from a condition that merely remains true across an unrelated event.

condition_memory_rows.rumoca-ir-solve: Per discrete output: whether it is a condition memory, the rows initialization seeds with `pre` following the current value.

condition_reads.rumoca-phase-structural: Condition roots (guards/triggers) evaluated at the tick.

conditional.rumoca-ir-ast: Whether this is a conditional component.

conditions.rumoca-ir-ast: The conditions evaluated, up to and including the one that held.

connected.rumoca-ir-flat: True if this variable is used in connection equations.

connector_type.rumoca-ir-flat: Reference to the connector type definition.

constrainedby.rumoca-ir-ast: Constraining type for replaceable components (MLS §7.3.2) If set, redeclarations must be subtypes of this type

constraining_modifications.rumoca-ir-ast: Constraining-clause modifiers of a replaceable class whose merge into its base's modifiers needs types (MLS §7.3.2, §7.2.3): a declared binding over them, a `final` conflict, or a class with no single base. Parsing keeps them here; instantiation merges or refuses them when the class is used.

continuation.rumoca-ir-dae: A Boolean expression of the loop body scope, evaluated on the carried state at the start of each iteration; the first false value ends the fold with that state (a bounded `while`, MLS §11.2.3).
continuation.rumoca-ir-solve: An early-exit predicate over the carried tuple, the captures and the binder values of the pass about to run, evaluated before each pass; the first false value ends the loop with the current tuple (MLS §11.2.3). The producer proves that every skipped pass would leave the tuple unchanged, so the domain stays the static capacity while a run-time bound such as `i <= n` decides how many passes execute.

continuous_partition.rumoca-ir-flat: The continuous-time partition (if any). This contains equations without explicit clock associations.

contradicted.rumoca-phase-structural: Per root: classes whose recorded equalities contradict each other, which prove nothing a transfer may stand on.

coordinate.rumoca-phase-structural: The coordinate the retained equation is stated about. Definitions and state checks name a state; direct checks name their algebraic/output.

coordinates.rumoca-ir-solve: None explicitly denotes dependence on the whole input leaf.

dead.rumoca-ir-solve: Operations that are neither planned nor emitted; empty when none is.

declaration_source_scope.rumoca-ir-ast: Lexical scope where this component declaration was written.

declared_causality.rumoca-ir-dae: The source `input`/`output` prefix. An exported `Input` or `Output` causality requires the same declared causality (SPEC_0040 DAE-C24).
declared_causality.rumoca-ir-solve: The declared prefix where it differs from `causality`; construction refuses one the exported causality already states.

def_id.rumoca-ir-ast: Resolved definition ID (populated by resolve phase). For simple type names, this is the DefId of the class being referenced. For qualified type names (e.g., `Medium.AbsolutePressure`), this may be the DefId of the first part if full resolution fails (partial resolution). Partial resolution indicates the name is valid but depends on a replaceable type parameter that will be resolved during instantiation (MLS §7.3).

def_map.rumoca-ir-ast: Map from DefId to qualified name (e.g., "Package.SubPackage.Model"). Populated during the resolve phase for O(1) resolved definition lookup.

default_tolerance.rumoca-ir-solve: Relative and absolute tolerance of the local error when the importer defines none (the FMI setup tolerance replaces it otherwise); equal to the native simulation's default tolerance.

definite_roots.rumoca-ir-flat: Connectors with Connections.root() declarations (MLS §9.4.1). These are definite roots for overconstrained connectors, providing implicit equations that don't need to come from external connections. Stores the full path to the overconstrained record (e.g., "pin_p.reference").

definition_scopes.rumoca-ir-dae: Region that owned each definition when construction issued it. Element `n` answers for `definitions[n]`: `None` when the definition was issued by the function's top-level body, and `Some(scope)` for the lexically innermost open region. The vector always advances with `definitions`, so a definition identity and its issuing scope are one construction fact and cannot drift apart.

delay_max_rhs.rumoca-ir-solve: Maximum retained history horizon. When source `delayMax` is omitted, this row is identical to the corresponding delay-time row.

delay_time_rhs.rumoca-ir-solve: Delay amount evaluated at the query time.

delta.rumoca-ir-solve: The faithful wire delta of this plan against the primary system, issued once by [`ChartPlanDelta::diff`] at construction or kept from decoding.

dependencies.rumoca-ir-solve: Per-output seed dependencies of each JVP program read so far; `None` when the program's dependencies are not derivable.

description.rumoca-ir-ast: Optional declaration description string (`"..."` after component declaration).
description.rumoca-ir-flat: Optional declaration description string (`"..."` after declaration).

dims.rumoca-ir-ast: Array dimensions (None means unknown size, e.g., from `:` subscript).
dims.rumoca-ir-flat: Resolved array dimensions (preserved per SPEC_0007 and SPEC_0032).

dims_expr.rumoca-ir-ast: Unevaluated dimension expressions for parameter-dependent sizes. These are evaluated during flattening when parameter values are known.

disabled_components.rumoca-ir-ast: Disabled conditional components (MLS §4.8). Contains structured instance component paths whose conditions evaluated to false. These components and their sub-components should be excluded from flattening.

discrete_input_runs.rumoca-ir-solve: Source storage runs of discrete-valued external inputs. A discrete-time input changes only at events (MLS §4.5), so a change the importer makes between Co-Simulation steps is an event at the next step's first instant.

discrete_order.rumoca-ir-solve: The evaluation orders of the parameter-determined discrete rows.

discrete_targets.rumoca-ir-solve: Per discrete output: its parameter target.

discretized_at.rumoca-ir-flat: Whether this is a discretized partition (contains der(), delay(), etc.). MLS §16.8.1: "If the partition contains a Discretized Variables, it is called discretized."

displaced.rumoca-phase-structural: Whether the two variables are separated by a displacement the residual does not prove zero. A displaced pair still shares a derivative; it does not share a value.

domain.rumoca-ir-dae: The compact domain this transition iterates. A function body carries an optional domain because a body outside every loop has none. A loop capability is minted from the domain it was begun with, so it keeps that domain itself rather than reading the body's option back and asserting that a loop always has one.
domain.rumoca-ir-flat: Compact index domain in source binder declaration order.

dropped.rumoca-ir-solve: Output slots whose stores are dead; empty when none is.

each.rumoca-ir-ast: True if the modification has `each` prefix (MLS §7.2.5).

each_modifications.rumoca-ir-ast: Set of modification names that have the `each` prefix (MLS §7.2.5). When applied to array components, `each`-prefixed modifications apply the same value to every element, while non-`each` modifications distribute array values.

each_modifier_bindings.rumoca-ir-ast: Component bindings introduced by an `each` modifier (MLS §7.2.5). This remains structured instantiation metadata so flattening can preserve element-wise modifier semantics when an array component stays compact.

edges.rumoca-ir-flat: Edges included in the spanning tree.

effective_types.rumoca-ir-ast: Concrete effective types produced after instance dimensions are resolved. Each component `type_id` names exactly one descriptor in this catalog after successful post-instantiation type checking.
effective_types.rumoca-ir-flat: Resolved effective type descriptors keyed by the exact `TypeId` stored on each concrete variable or aggregate instance.

elements.rumoca-ir-ast: Public named elements with their interfaces (recursive).

else_branch.rumoca-ir-flat: Source-present else branch; `Some([])` is distinct from no else.

empty.rumoca-ir-solve: Issued from the operation rule and captured source witnesses.

end_name_token.rumoca-ir-ast: Token for the class name in "end ClassName;" (for rename support)

enum_literal_ordinals.rumoca-ir-flat: Enumeration literal ordinal map (MLS §4.9.5, 1-based ordinals). Keys are canonical literal paths (e.g. `Modelica.Electrical.Digital.Interfaces.Logic.'1'`), values are integer ordinals used by runtime numeric evaluation.

enum_literals.rumoca-ir-ast: Enumeration literals for enum types (e.g., `type MyEnum = enumeration(A "desc", B, C)`)

enumeration.rumoca-ir-dae: The declaration of the enumeration type of an enumeration variable (MLS §4.9.5), so a consumer that exposes the variable names its literals.
enumeration.rumoca-ir-solve: The declaration of the enumeration type of an `Enumeration` declaration (MLS §4.9.5).

enumeration_declarations.rumoca-ir-flat: Declaration of each enumeration type, keyed by the exact canonical type identity of `enumeration_type_roots` (MLS §4.9.5).

enumeration_type_roots.rumoca-ir-ast: Canonical `TypeId`s proven by typechecking to denote enumerations. Effective component identities remain in `enumeration_types`; this root catalog also covers function values that do not have component occurrences in the instance overlay.
enumeration_type_roots.rumoca-ir-flat: Canonical type identities proven to denote enumerations.

enumeration_types.rumoca-ir-ast: Effective type identities whose exact canonical root is an enumeration. Typecheck constructs this set from its resolved `TypeTable`; later phases never infer enumeration semantics from a rendered type name.
enumeration_types.rumoca-ir-flat: Effective type identities whose exact canonical root is an enumeration.

equations.rumoca-ir-flat: Equations active when the condition triggers.

equations_per_point.rumoca-ir-flat: Uniform scalar-view equation count emitted by each domain point. A structured family is retained only when this count is uniform, keeping its metadata independent of domain cardinality.
equations_per_point.rumoca-phase-structural: Scalar equations emitted per domain point.

evaluable.rumoca-ir-dae: A `final` or `Evaluate=true` parameter or constant whose declaration binding is evaluable (MLS §4.5, §18.6; SPEC_0040 STRUCT-T10).
evaluable.rumoca-ir-solve: A parameter whose value is fixed at translation (MLS §4.5, §18.3).

evaluate.rumoca-ir-ast: True if this parameter has annotation(Evaluate=true) or is declared final. Structural parameters can be evaluated at compile time for if-equation branch selection (MLS §18.3).
evaluate.rumoca-ir-flat: True if this parameter has annotation(Evaluate=true) or is declared final. Structural parameters can be evaluated at compile time for if-equation branch selection (MLS §18.3).

evaluate_refused.rumoca-ir-ast: True if the declaration writes `annotation(Evaluate = false)`, which makes the parameter non-evaluable (MLS §4.5, §18.6).
evaluate_refused.rumoca-ir-flat: True if the declaration writes `annotation(Evaluate = false)`, which makes the parameter non-evaluable (MLS §4.5, §18.6).

event_transactions.rumoca-ir-solve: Model-level event algorithms remain one ordered typed transaction across mixed discrete Real and discrete-valued storage.

exact.rumoca-ir-solve: Registers that hold exactly a chosen parameter or a constant.
exact.rumoca-phase-structural: Classes proven equal up to sign, with no displacement between members. Answers every question about a value.

expandable.rumoca-ir-ast: True if the class is declared with the `expandable` keyword (MLS §9.1.3) Only meaningful for connector classes

external.rumoca-ir-ast: External function declaration (MLS §12.9). Only meaningful for function classes.

external_object_name.rumoca-ir-ast: If derived from ExternalObject, the full name.

external_tables.rumoca-ir-dae: Loaded native table descriptors (MLS §12.9.7 ExternalObject handles) that the constructor fold produced, keyed by the opaque integer id each handle parameter binds to. The solver interpolates these with its native table operators instead of calling foreign C code.

fallback_scan_resolution.rumoca-ir-solve: The scan resolution of an experiment without a finite positive width.

family.rumoca-ir-ast: Compact authoritative form for a regular vectorized connection. `a` and `b` above are the domain's first scalar member for diagnostic and compatibility views. Flattening derives all scalar members from this family at its input boundary.

field_def_id.rumoca-ir-ast: Exact declaration identity of the projected field after resolution.

final_.rumoca-ir-ast: True if the modification has `final` prefix (MLS §7.2.6).

final_attributes.rumoca-ir-ast: Set of attribute names that are marked as final (e.g., "start" if `final start = 1.0`) When a derived class tries to override these attributes, an error should be raised

finished.rumoca-ir-solve: Finished outputs per (summary, output type), while no argument has been reassigned.

first_equation_index.rumoca-ir-flat: First equation index in the corresponding flat equation vector.

first_row.rumoca-phase-structural: First incidence row the family occupies. Published because the compact form names no individual equation, so a consumer checking that the blocks **partition** the equations has no other way to learn which rows this block accounts for. `origin` is a description and the two counts are a size; neither locates the family in the incidence.

fixed.rumoca-ir-ast: Fixed attribute, scalarized per component element (MLS §4.8, §4.8.6). A single value broadcasts over every element; an array carries one value per element.
fixed.rumoca-ir-flat: Fixed attribute, scalarized per array element (MLS §4.8, §4.8.6). A single value broadcasts over every element; an array carries one value per element.

formal.rumoca-phase-structural: A generated index-reduction declaration: a formal-derivative coordinate.

formal_aliases.rumoca-phase-structural: The second, formal-derivative application of the quotient on the reduced candidate Solve lowering executes, when one exists.

from_expandable_connector.rumoca-ir-ast: True if this variable comes from an expandable connector (MLS §9.1.3). Unconnected expandable connector members without bindings are unused.
from_expandable_connector.rumoca-ir-flat: True if this variable comes from an expandable connector (MLS §9.1.3). Unconnected expandable connector members without bindings are unused and shouldn't count as unknowns in the DAE balance calculation.

fully_seeded_ranges.rumoca-phase-structural: Row ranges in which *every* row was seeded, ascending and disjoint. Kuhn never needs to look at these rows again.

function.rumoca-ir-ast: The differentiated function, looked up as in a short class definition.

function_def.rumoca-ir-flat: The function that computes the residual. Prototype: `function equalityConstraint(a: T, b: T) -> Real[n]`

function_name.rumoca-ir-ast: External function name (defaults to Modelica function name if not specified).

function_sources.rumoca-ir-solve: The checked function each owner refines, in owner order.

functions.rumoca-ir-flat: User-defined functions used by this model (MLS §12).
functions.rumoca-ir-solve: The block's functions as pure-call owners, which every method may call.

global_scope.rumoca-ir-ast: True if import uses global scope (leading dot: `import .A.B.{C, D};`)

group.rumoca-ir-solve: Steps answered by one evaluation of this step's program, counting itself; zero when an earlier step's evaluation answers it.

guarded_assignments.rumoca-ir-solve: Correlated guarded updates retain one compact result program and one ordered target-range catalog. Scalar coordinate rows are derived only by evaluator/backend adapters.

guarded_clocks.rumoca-ir-solve: Per guarded-assignment output: the periodic clock that owns it, which gates it to that clock's ticks and to the first pass of an event.

guarded_jacobian_v.rumoca-ir-solve: Program `i` differentiates guarded assignment `i`, output for output.

guarded_targets.rumoca-ir-solve: Per guarded-assignment output, in program order: its target.

has_explicit_binding.rumoca-ir-ast: True if an explicit binding equation (= value) was provided in the declaration This distinguishes `constant Real c = 0;` (has_explicit_binding=true) from `constant Real c;` (has_explicit_binding=false, even though start may have a default)

has_forwarding_class_redeclare.rumoca-ir-ast: True when this component applies a self-forwarding class/package redeclare (e.g., `redeclare package Medium = Medium`) that is remapped to an active enclosing override during instantiation (MLS §7.3).

has_unapplied_redeclare.rumoca-ir-ast: A nested component redeclaration has not yet been applied by Instantiate. Descendant dimension facts must remain unknown until it is consumed.

id.rumoca-ir-ast: Unique identifier for this state machine.
id.rumoca-ir-flat: Unique identifier within the base partition.

in_spanning_tree.rumoca-ir-flat: Whether this edge is in the spanning tree.

inconsistent.rumoca-phase-structural: Classes whose edges contradict each other and prove nothing usable.

index.rumoca-ir-solve: Fixed with `stages`; every constructor derives it from them.

indices.rumoca-ir-solve: Scalar Integer registers containing one-based Modelica coordinates.

inert_states.rumoca-phase-structural: STRUCT-T04: states declared algebraic whose derivative reads rebuild as zero.

inherited_members.rumoca-ir-ast: Effective members contributed by resolved extends clauses. `InheritedMember::Ambiguous` records an ambiguous inherited name without choosing one base.

initial_algorithms.rumoca-ir-ast: Initial algorithm sections from this instance.

initial_assert_equations.rumoca-ir-flat: Runtime assertion equations from initial equation sections (MLS §8.6, §8.3.7).

initial_homotopy_parameter_index.rumoca-ir-solve: Hidden P-slot used by initialization residuals that contain `homotopy(actual, simplified)`. The initialization driver advances this value from zero to one. Models without homotopy expressions omit the slot entirely.

initial_state.rumoca-ir-ast: The initial state (exactly one state must be marked initial).

initial_structured_equations.rumoca-ir-flat: Structured source equation families for initial equations.

inline_calls.rumoca-phase-structural: STRUCT-T10(b): source call nodes replaced by their substituted body.

inner.rumoca-ir-ast: True if declared with 'inner' prefix (provides instance to outer references)

inner_outer_to_parent_inner.rumoca-ir-ast: Mapping from inner-outer component paths to their parent inner paths (MLS §5.4). When a component is declared `inner outer` (e.g., `inner outer StateGraphRoot stateGraphRoot`), it bridges two scopes: it serves as `inner` for children and as `outer` referencing the parent. Same-level connections involving the `inner outer` component should redirect to the parent's inner for flow equation scoping (e.g., `makeProduct.stateGraphRoot` → `stateGraphRoot`).

input_scalar_names.rumoca-ir-solve: One name and shape per input declaration; scalar names are derived.

inputs.rumoca-ir-ast: The differentiated inputs, in application order.

instance_id.rumoca-ir-ast: Unique identifier for this class instance.
instance_id.rumoca-ir-flat: Exact runtime occurrence identity allocated by instantiation.

instance_relations.rumoca-ir-flat: Exact occurrence graph transferred from the instantiated tree. Source `DefId`s remain declaration provenance. Concrete containment and aggregate-to-materialization proofs use `InstanceId` exclusively.

instants.rumoca-ir-solve: Static instants of `when time >= c` events and discontinuous time relations (the problem's scheduled time events).

integrator_history_effects.rumoca-ir-solve: Compiler-derived effect of changing each scalar update target on an integrator's continuous multistep history. This vector is row-aligned with `rhs`. A runtime may join the effect with exact update changes, but must not recover it from row position or model identity.

interiors.rumoca-ir-flat: Whether the interior cells' scalar bodies are materialized in the equation vector, and when they are not, which construction owns the family's body. A family flattened with `FlattenOptions::materialize_structured_families = false` keeps full bodies only in its corner cells (base + one neighbor per binder); every other cell is a placeholder that no consumer may read.

intermediate_consumers.rumoca-phase-structural: Consumer producer indices for every issued intermediate variable. This is derived by the same dependency walk that issued `steps`. Solve lowering maps the consumers to their typed clock domains once; a runtime must not rediscover this liveness from programs or storage.

intervals_since_event.rumoca-ir-solve: Intervals begun since the latest state event.

invariant.rumoca-phase-structural: Per root: the constant value the system proves the root holds.

invariant_columns.rumoca-phase-structural: Columns whose coordinate is a parameter-constant algebraic. Their offset is pinned to zero and their derivatives are always available as the zero constant, so a differentiated equation that reads one never raises its order.

invocations.rumoca-ir-solve: Cardinality issued by the canonical domain validator.

is_class.rumoca-ir-ast: Whether this represents a class (vs component).

is_connector_type.rumoca-ir-ast: True if this component's type is a `connector` class (MLS §4.7). Per MLS §4.7, only flow variables in top-level public connector components count toward the local equation size. Models/blocks (like Delta) are NOT interface connectors even if they contain sub-connectors.

is_discrete_type.rumoca-ir-ast: True if the base type is Integer or Boolean (MLS §4.5). These types are discrete by default even without explicit `discrete` prefix.
is_discrete_type.rumoca-ir-flat: True if this variable's base type is Integer or Boolean (MLS §4.5). Such variables are discrete by default even without explicit `discrete` prefix. This is used during variable classification to correctly identify discrete variables for the DAE balance calculation.

is_expandable_connector_type.rumoca-ir-ast: True if this component's type is an expandable connector (MLS §9.1.3). Kept on the container instance because an empty expandable connector has no flattened descendants from which later phases could recover this semantic fact.

is_final.rumoca-ir-ast: True if declared with 'final' prefix (cannot be redeclared in derived classes) MLS §7.2.6: "A final declaration in an element modification prevents modification"

is_flow.rumoca-ir-flat: Whether all variables in this set have flow prefix.

is_initial.rumoca-ir-ast: Whether this is the initial state (from initialState()). MLS §17.1: "One and only one instance in each state machine must be marked as initial."

is_inside.rumoca-ir-flat: Whether this is an inside connector (sign = +1) or outside connector (sign = -1). MLS §9.2: "The sign is +1 for inside connectors and -1 for outside connectors."

is_overconstrained.rumoca-ir-ast: True if this variable belongs to an overconstrained connector (MLS §9.4). A connector is overconstrained if its type defines an `equalityConstraint` function.
is_overconstrained.rumoca-ir-flat: True if this variable belongs to an overconstrained connector (MLS §9.4). A connector is overconstrained if its type defines an `equalityConstraint` function.

is_partial.rumoca-ir-ast: True if the root model is declared with the `partial` keyword. MLS §4.7: Partial models are incomplete and shouldn't be balance-checked.
is_partial.rumoca-ir-flat: True if the model is declared with the `partial` keyword. MLS §4.7: Partial models are incomplete and shouldn't be balance-checked.

is_partial_application.rumoca-ir-ast: True for the grammar form `function F(bound = value)`. A partial application is a function value, not a call result. The parser must preserve that distinction through semantic checking.

is_primitive.rumoca-ir-ast: True if this is a primitive type (Real, Integer, Boolean, String). False for class types (connectors, models, records, etc.) which are containers and should not appear as flat variables.
is_primitive.rumoca-ir-flat: True if this variable is a primitive type (Real, Integer, Boolean, String). Record-typed variables (like Complex with .re and .im fields) are not primitive. Non-primitive variables should not be counted as unknowns since their fields are counted separately. MLS §4.8: Balance checking uses expanded scalar counts.

is_protected.rumoca-ir-ast: True if this component is declared in a protected section (MLS §4.7). Protected components are not part of the public interface and their flow variables should not count as interface flows for balance checking.
is_protected.rumoca-ir-flat: True if this component is declared in a protected section (MLS §4.7). Protected components are not part of the public interface and their flow variables should not count as interface flows for balance checking.

is_redeclare.rumoca-ir-ast: True if declared with element-level `redeclare` prefix.

is_replaceable.rumoca-ir-ast: True if declared with 'replaceable' prefix (can be redeclared in derived classes) MLS §7.3: "A replaceable element is an element that can be replaced by a different element"

is_stream.rumoca-ir-flat: Whether all variables in this set have stream prefix.

is_structural.rumoca-ir-ast: True if this is a structural parameter (MLS §18.3) Structural parameters affect array sizes, for-loop ranges, or if-equation conditions and must be evaluable at translation time.

iterates_discretes.rumoca-ir-solve: Whether a planned row reads a discrete coordinate the projection holds at its current value. The runtime then alternates the projection with the discrete assignments until the discrete values stop changing, the fixed point of the MLS §8.6 mixed initialization system.

iteration_lanes.rumoca-ir-solve: The pre bindings (indices into `pre_bindings`) an event pass advances and whose settlement ends the iteration.

iteration_locals.rumoca-ir-dae: Function locals defined afresh inside each iteration. They belong to the transition region but are neither initialized from nor returned in the carried tuple.

kind.rumoca-ir-dae: Which clocked coordinate role the owned variable was checked to have. Ownership is only ever minted after `own` rejects any other role, so the entry carries the outcome of that check rather than leaving a reader to re-derive it from the variable arena. The wire form omits it: replay re-issues the same checked operation and reproduces it.
kind.rumoca-ir-flat: The structural use the read parameters fix.

last_event.rumoca-ir-solve: Time of each indicator's latest state event.

lhs_pattern.rumoca-ir-solve: Sparsity of the lhs (A) operand.  `Dense` unless the lowering phase can statically prove a sparser structure.

literal_expressions.rumoca-phase-structural: SPEC_0043 §4: source expressions replaced by their literal values.

literals.rumoca-phase-structural: Literal values that replace constant expressions of function bodies.

loaded.rumoca-ir-solve: Slots some running operation loads; empty when every slot is.

local.rumoca-ir-ast: Whether this reference starts with a `.` (local lookup).

location.rumoca-ir-ast: Full source location spanning from class keyword to end statement

low_weight.rumoca-ir-solve: The Illinois weights of the indicator values held at each end.

manifold.rumoca-phase-structural: Constraint expressions an index reduction left on the state manifold.

manifold_projection_plan.rumoca-ir-solve: Connected state-coordinate blocks used to project accepted numerical steps onto `manifold_residual = 0`. Blocks may have more state coordinates than residual rows; runtimes use a minimum-norm correction.

manifold_redundant.rumoca-phase-structural: Redundancy classification parallel to `manifold`: `true` marks a row of a loop-closure constraint that must reduce, `false` a conserved first integral that may be retained.

manifold_residual.rumoca-ir-solve: Lower-order holonomic and velocity residuals retained when structural index reduction replaces them with acceleration-level equations.

map.rumoca-ir-solve: Program register to the segment register holding its value.

match_eq.rumoca-phase-structural: The matching as of this instant: `match_eq[i] = Some(j)` means equation `i` owns variable `j`.

match_tolerance.rumoca-ir-solve: The relative tolerance within which two instants are one instant (`SCHEDULE_TIME_RELATIVE_TOLERANCE`).

matching.rumoca-phase-structural: Maximum matching as `(equation, unknown)` pairs — which equation determines which variable.

matrix_pattern.rumoca-ir-solve: Constructor-derived structural pattern of the square coefficient matrix. Runtime values never redefine this relation.

max_substeps.rumoca-ir-solve: Attempted substeps one communication step may take before it is discarded.

memory.rumoca-ir-solve: The relation-memory parameter this root writes, if any.

min_factor.rumoca-ir-solve: Smallest and largest factor one substep may change the step size by.

minmax_slack.rumoca-ir-solve: Evaluations the refinement may take beyond the bisection count of its bracket: the `n0` of the minmax projection.

model_description.rumoca-ir-flat: Optional description string from the root class declaration.

model_root_count.rumoca-ir-solve: Length of the model root prefix of that vector.

modifications.rumoca-ir-ast: Component modifications (e.g., R=10 in `Resistor R1(R=10)`) Maps parameter name to its modified value expression

n_equations.rumoca-phase-structural: Number of equations in the analyzed system.

n_unknowns.rumoca-phase-structural: Number of unknowns in the analyzed system.

name.rumoca-ir-ast: The parameter name token (with source location)

name_map.rumoca-ir-ast: Inverse map from qualified name to DefId for O(1) resolved definition lookup. This includes non-class definitions such as components. Populated during the resolve phase alongside def_map.

name_token.rumoca-ir-ast: The token for the component name with exact source location

names.rumoca-ir-ast: All names imported from the package.

native.rumoca-ir-dae: The SPEC_0040 DAE-C30 compiler-defined body this interface is proven to match, derived by construction and never read from the wire.

native_assignment.rumoca-ir-solve: The stateless native value schedule or why the problem has none; `None` until [`issue_native_assignment_schedule`] runs.

negated.rumoca-phase-structural: Whether the variable is the negation of the root's value.

nested_machine.rumoca-ir-ast: Nested state machine (for hierarchical state machines).

next.rumoca-ir-solve: The first term no value or slot owns yet.

next_id.rumoca-ir-ast: Number of occurrence identities allocated so far. Allocation is one-based because `InstanceId::UNSET` reserves zero, so this is also the last identity handed out.

next_wire_expression.rumoca-ir-dae: Emitted-record cursor over `wire.expressions.nodes`. It trails `expressions.len()` (the source-ordinal cursor) by six for every replayed model owner.

nodes.rumoca-ir-flat: Nodes in the graph (overdetermined type/record instances).

notes.rumoca-phase-structural: Scope notes a reader needs to interpret this analysis, such as a reduced state selection that executes a different system.

num_constraints.rumoca-ir-flat: Number of scalar constraint equations (n in `Real[n]`).

numbered_values.rumoca-ir-solve: Whether repeated scalar computations share a register; a replayed wire keeps every recorded register.

observation_reads_y.rumoca-ir-solve: Whether an observation row reads a solver coordinate, so the algebraic refresh and the rows alternate until they agree.

observation_refresh_reads_y.rumoca-ir-solve: Construction certificate: at least one selected scalar observation row reads Y storage and therefore must be rechecked after continuous algebraic projection. False proves that one discrete refresh followed by one projection is the complete public fixed point.

observation_rows.rumoca-ir-solve: Per discrete output: whether a public observation recomputes it from the observed coordinate (an unread B.1c owner, SPEC_0022 EXPR-012).

observed.rumoca-ir-dae: The targets are unread observations of a continuous-time definition, evaluated at every output point (SPEC_0022 EXPR-012).

oc_break_edge_scalar_count.rumoca-ir-flat: Conservative scalar budget for VCG break-edge equations (MLS §9.4). Break edges are lowered to their declared `equalityConstraint` equations during connection generation. Balance accounting retains this metadata to validate the resulting equation inventory.

oc_eq_constraint_size.rumoca-ir-ast: The output size of the enclosing record's equalityConstraint function. E.g., 3 for Orientation (returns `Real[3]`).
oc_eq_constraint_size.rumoca-ir-flat: The output size of the enclosing record's equalityConstraint function. E.g., 3 for Orientation (returns `Real[3]`).

oc_record_path.rumoca-ir-ast: The path of the enclosing overconstrained record (MLS §9.4). E.g., "frame_a.R" for variables frame_a.R.T and frame_a.R.w. Used to group OC variables into VCG nodes for balance correction.
oc_record_path.rumoca-ir-flat: The path of the enclosing overconstrained record (MLS §9.4). E.g., "frame_a.R" for variables frame_a.R.T and frame_a.R.w. Used to group OC variables into VCG nodes for balance correction.

occurrences.rumoca-phase-structural: The unknown occurrences of the row being projected, reused across rows.

offset.rumoca-phase-structural: The displacement between the variable and the (signed) root value.

opaque.rumoca-ir-solve: An event owner whose targets are not enumerated here (an aggregate transaction or a structured update) exists, so no bound is claimed.

operator_record.rumoca-ir-ast: True if the class is declared with the `operator` keyword (MLS §14) Only meaningful for record classes (operator record)

operator_record_base.rumoca-ir-ast: If this is an operator record, the base class identity.

optional_edges.rumoca-ir-flat: Optional edges derived from connect() statements for overconstrained nodes (MLS §9.4). These are used together with `branches` when building the virtual connection graph.

origin.rumoca-ir-ast: Origin of this statement (qualified name of the class it came from).
origin.rumoca-ir-flat: Typed origin for scoped parameter/constant substitution.
origin.rumoca-phase-structural: The formal value coordinate of the source declaration at order zero, of which `value` is the `order`-th formal derivative.

outer.rumoca-ir-ast: True if declared with 'outer' prefix (references an inner instance from enclosing scope)

outer_prefix_to_inner.rumoca-ir-ast: Mapping from outer-prefixed paths to their corresponding inner paths (MLS §5.4). When an outer component `initialStep.stateGraphRoot` references inner `stateGraphRoot`, equations/connections using the outer prefix are redirected to the inner path.

output.rumoca-ir-ast: Output variable that receives the return value (if any).

output_lane.rumoca-ir-solve: None means every output lane; otherwise only this output lane.

outputs.rumoca-ir-ast: Output variables being assigned (for `(a, b) := func(x)` style calls)

owner.rumoca-ir-dae: First projection node issued for this exact source call occurrence. Every result projection shares this identity and operand range.
owner.rumoca-ir-solve: The projection block solving each algebraic (solver `state_count + k`).

owner_class_id.rumoca-ir-ast: Exact class occurrence that owns this component.

owner_component_id.rumoca-ir-ast: Exact structured component occurrence whose type instantiated this class. The root model has no component owner.

owner_expression_extra.rumoca-ir-dae: Extra target expression nodes produced by owner replays (six per model owner).

owner_first_row.rumoca-phase-structural: First scalar row of each continuous owner, terminated by `n_eq`, so owner `i` occupies rows `owner_first_row[i]..owner_first_row[i + 1]`. This lets the incremental reduction copy an untouched owner's rows verbatim from a prior round.

owner_operand_extra.rumoca-ir-dae: Extra target packed operands produced by owner replays (three per model owner, two per function owner).

packed_value_counts.rumoca-ir-dae: Packed scalar width of every value type, derived once at freeze.

parameter_branch_selections.rumoca-ir-ast: If-equations whose branch instantiation selected by evaluating component references (SPEC_0040 DAE-C22).
parameter_branch_selections.rumoca-ir-flat: Branch selections flatten made by evaluating a parameter guard at translation (SPEC_0040 DAE-C22): an if-equation whose branches differ in equation count or in the variables they differentiate.

parameters.rumoca-ir-solve: Parameter storage indices an event writes: discrete values, relation and condition memory, `pre` copies, and clock activation lanes.

parent.rumoca-ir-dae: Owner-local ordinal of the loop this one is lexically nested inside.
parent.rumoca-phase-structural: Union-find parent per whole variable or authored component identity.

parity.rumoca-phase-structural: Whether each variable is the negation of its parent's value.

partial.rumoca-ir-ast: True if the class is declared with the `partial` keyword

partial_derivative.rumoca-ir-ast: Partial-derivative definition `f = der(g, u1, ...)` (MLS §12.7.2). A class carrying this has no body of its own: its meaning is the derivative of `g`, never `g` itself.

parts.rumoca-ir-ast: The parts of the reference (e.g., `a.b.c` has 3 parts).

pass_lanes.rumoca-ir-solve: For a loop operation: the exactness of the operations of one pass.

pending.rumoca-phase-structural: Expressions whose derivative is still to be followed.

phasor.rumoca-ir-solve: For a scalar whose defining equation makes it the angle of a phasor, or the cosine of that angle, the phasor's component scalars; `None` for every other visible scalar.

pinned.rumoca-ir-ast: Declarations an outer modification already gave a value.
pinned.rumoca-phase-structural: Whether the model pins that start with `fixed = true`.

pins.rumoca-phase-structural: MLS 3.6 §8.6 initial equations rewritten onto the state each one determines. The proof that decides which stated value defines a state and which one only restates it lives in this phase's `initial_pins` module, which is private — naming it as a doc link would make the public page point at an item its reader cannot open.

placements.rumoca-ir-solve: `(lane, program output offset, destination offset)` of every value this evaluation places.

plan.rumoca-ir-solve: The positional reading of `sources` every executor uses: where each position reads its value, the side an exact zero takes, and the relation memory a crossing reseeds (SPEC_0044 ME-EVENT-005).

point_count.rumoca-phase-structural: Number of domain points the family covers.

poisoned_from.rumoca-ir-solve: Every register at or above this one is unknown (a compact op whose extent is not enumerable).

post_commit_assignment_rhs.rumoca-ir-solve: Relation-free root-driven assignments that remain valid after event `pre` history has committed.

post_commit_assignment_runtime_rows.rumoca-ir-solve: Runtime-row owner copied by each post-commit row. Shape validation proves the copy is exact and the owner is relation-free.

potential_roots.rumoca-ir-flat: Potential roots from Connections.potentialRoot(a, priority) calls (MLS §9.4).

pre_bindings.rumoca-ir-solve: Destination and source of every pre binding, in binding order.

pre_param_bindings.rumoca-ir-solve: Snapshot bindings for `__pre__.*` parameters created by DAE-IR pre_lowering. At event entry the runtime copies each source slot into the corresponding dest P-slot before the event equations evaluate.

predefined_members.rumoca-ir-ast: Predefined names that remain visible at an encapsulated boundary.

predefined_string_declaration.rumoca-ir-flat: Exact Resolve identity of the predefined `String` declaration. Production flattening always supplies this from `ScopeTree`; downstream phases use it to distinguish the predefined conversion operator from a shadowing user declaration without rendered-name lookup.

predefined_types.rumoca-ir-flat: Exact canonical identities for predefined scalar types.

priority.rumoca-ir-ast: Priority of this transition (MLS §17.1: "priority >= 1"). Lower number = higher priority. Default: 1
priority.rumoca-ir-flat: Priority value (lower = higher priority). Must be >= 0.

program_register_counts.rumoca-ir-solve: Construction-owned execution capacity for each stored program. This proof is rebuilt on wire replay and deliberately is not serialized as a second source of truth.

programs.rumoca-ir-solve: Multi-lane programs; empty when the plan evaluates one direction at a time through the JVP programs.

pulse_rows.rumoca-ir-solve: Pulse-memory outputs and their checked producing programs. Only these programs are evaluated when the event releases its clock pulses.

pure.rumoca-ir-ast: True if the function is pure (no side effects). MLS §12.3. Only meaningful for function classes. Functions are pure by default. Set to false when declared with `impure` keyword.

pure_calls.rumoca-ir-solve: Exact pure DAE call frames shared by value, root, action, and visible projections. Empty minimal fixtures still carry the canonical binary64 arithmetic profile; lowering never reconstructs this table from rows.

purity_declared.rumoca-ir-ast: True when the source declared `pure` or `impure` explicitly (MLS §12.3; external functions without an explicit declaration are deprecated, FUNC-032).

qualified_display_name.rumoca-ir-ast: Non-semantic qualified display spelling. Resolution and identity proofs use only `parts`; this cache is ignored by equality and serialization. It spells the leading parts that stay on one reference when the reference is lowered — every part of an unsubscripted reference, and the parts up to and including the first subscripted one otherwise, always without subscripts. Lowering splits at that first subscripted part, so a spelling that covered more parts could not be attached to anything.

qualified_name.rumoca-ir-ast: Qualified name of the state machine instance.

quotient_replays.rumoca-ir-dae: One slot per owner record in source order — the single global owner ordinal the stream markers name. Function owners hold a typed placeholder markers must reject; model owners hold the staged token consumed by their three markers and finished after roots.

raised_owners.rumoca-phase-structural: `(first canonical row, order before this admission)` per raised owner.

rank.rumoca-phase-structural: Union-by-rank bound on parent depth; ties keep the lower root. Variable identities are `u32`, so the rank cannot exceed 32.

rates.rumoca-phase-structural: Explicit derivative definitions, read as values.

reach.rumoca-ir-solve: The largest `end` among this run and every run sorted before it.

reached.rumoca-ir-solve: Tear columns whose tangents reach the step through the rows it reads.

read_boundary.rumoca-phase-structural: This row refreshes an ordinary event value, not an MLS16 history view.

read_context.rumoca-phase-structural: Construction-issued current/entry facts, or the synchronous boundary.

real_eighths.rumoca-ir-dae: Eighths, so the payload is a dyadic rational. The Real payload is deliberately not an arbitrary double. The workspace builds `serde_json` without its `float_roundtrip` feature (root `Cargo.toml` asks only for `preserve_order`), and its default number parser can land one ULP away from the correctly rounded value: reading back `-122.50221691932535` yields the neighbouring double, whose own shortest form is `-122.50221691932536`. That is a payload-fidelity defect of the name-tagged codec, not an ordinal defect — `bincode` carries the eight raw bytes and is unaffected — so this harness draws Reals from the domain both codecs represent exactly and leaves the defect to be fixed where it lives, in the workspace dependency declaration.

record_field_prefixes.rumoca-ir-dae: Per record type, the running sum of its field packed widths (one entry past the last field), derived once at freeze; `None` for a non-record or a record whose layout does not fit.

record_instances.rumoca-ir-flat: Resolved record containers retained for record-equation lowering. Record fields remain the authoritative Flat variables. This table only preserves the compact type identity discarded when containers expand.

record_types.rumoca-ir-flat: Resolved field layout for each record declaration used by an instance. This is type metadata, not callable-function reachability. Record equations use it to preserve one tensor equation per declared field.

redeclare.rumoca-ir-ast: True if the modification is a redeclaration (MLS §7.3).

redeclare_target_def_id.rumoca-ir-ast: Resolved inherited class slot replaced by this declaration (MLS §7.3). This is semantic identity, not a same-spelling heuristic. It is populated by name resolution after the containing class's extends graph is available.

redeclared_by_modification.rumoca-ir-ast: True once an `extends` modification has redeclared this inherited component (MLS §7.3, `extends Base(redeclare C a[2])`). This records the redeclaration's presence. Type and dimension application are separate from other component prefixes and modifiers.

reduced.rumoca-phase-structural: The integrated state map and admissible reduced charts issued by the formal-derivative selection. Empty except on the reduced-selection path that finalizes a formal state candidate.

reduced_chart_set.rumoca-ir-solve: Admissible reduced state-selection charts for a definitional first-integral coordinate group. A conserved first integral has no globally injective reduced chart: the fixed primary basis folds when one of its dependent coordinates passes through zero. Each chart in this bounded set is one alternate Dependent/Independent column selection of that group, expressed in the same solver-Y space as the primary basis, so a runtime can re-select a regular chart across such a fold. Chart index zero is the primary basis. An empty set is dropped from human-readable serialization, so a model with no chart set has byte-identical JSON to one that predates the field; positional binary formats keep the field so their fixed layout still round-trips. Each alternate plan travels as a delta against this system (see `continuous_wire`).

redundant.rumoca-phase-structural: Whether this row belongs to a redundant loop-closure constraint. A conserved first integral (its lower-order form is implied by the ODE, so one differentiation already reconstructs a matched state derivative) is definitional and keeps `false`; a genuine loop closure, whose position form is over-determining and is closed only by differentiating to acceleration through a multiplier, is redundant and carries `true`.

references.rumoca-ir-flat: Per component reference its evaluated conditions read, the flat names it can denote, the innermost enclosing scope first.

refinement_iteration_cap.rumoca-ir-solve: Refinement evaluations a bracket may take before location fails typed. It exceeds every bound the minmax projection proves for a bracket at most `2^(cap - slack)` location tolerances wide.

refresh_on_tick.rumoca-phase-structural: Exact always-active discrete definitions must execute inside a clock partition when one of its producers reads them. Their stored entry value predates the tick, even when they do not depend on another clock-owned producer (for example `fresh = valid and sample(...)`).

refresh_owners.rumoca-ir-solve: Exact checked refresh owners issued during Solve construction. Runtime adapters prepare these schedules but never discover or filter them.

register_listed_twice.rumoca-ir-solve: Whether the last reader lists the register more than once.

regular.rumoca-ir-flat: Family-native classification: present when this family is a regular elementwise stencil whose array accesses are all affine in the binders, carrying the per-access stride table the Solve-IR lowering needs to build a compact `AffineStencil` without materializing one row per index tuple. `None` means the family is materialized the historical (scalar) way.

removed_edges.rumoca-ir-flat: Edges removed from the spanning tree (will use equalityConstraint).

required.rumoca-ir-flat: Whether this was a required edge (from Connections.branch()).

required_edges.rumoca-ir-flat: Edges from Connections.branch() (required - cannot be removed).

reset.rumoca-ir-ast: Whether the target state is reset when the transition fires. Default: true

residual_eq_local_indices.rumoca-phase-structural: Indices of residual equations within the block's equation list. Same count as `tear_var_local_indices`.

residual_equations.rumoca-phase-structural: Residual equation labels, one per tear variable.

residual_rows.rumoca-ir-solve: Residual rows forming the reduced Newton system driven to zero over the tear variables. A subset of the block's `rows`.

resolved_imports.rumoca-ir-ast: Resolved import map: short name → fully-qualified name (MLS §13.2). Collected from the class definition and its entire inheritance chain. Used during flattening to resolve imported short names (e.g., `pi` → `Modelica.Constants.pi`) instead of incorrectly qualifying them with the component instance prefix.

result.rumoca-ir-dae: Output bound by the MLS §12.9 `output = symbol(...)` return form.

retained_states.rumoca-phase-structural: Other states of the class, which keep their role and edge equation.

reusable.rumoca-phase-structural: The incidence of the current system while its manifold is empty, so a direct round reuses untouched rows and screens candidates exactly as the outer direct lane does.

reuse.rumoca-phase-structural: The prior round's incidence, reused for owners this demotion leaves untouched; `None` disables reuse and rebuilds the incidence in full.

rhs_pattern.rumoca-ir-solve: Sparsity of the rhs (B) operand.  `Dense` unless statically known.

role.rumoca-phase-structural: How the runtime must enforce it.

root_description.rumoca-ir-ast: Optional description string from the root class declaration.

root_neighborhoods.rumoca-ir-solve: Per root output: the outputs reading a coordinate it reads, itself included (ME-EVENT-008 mode search).

root_relation_refresh_roles.rumoca-ir-solve: Compiler certificate describing which root memories may participate in post-commit algebraic coupling.

root_value_count.rumoca-ir-solve: Length of the runtime root-condition vector: model roots then delays.

roots.rumoca-ir-flat: Root nodes selected for this tree.
roots.rumoca-ir-solve: Per root output: whether and how it is evaluated in Event Mode.

roundoff_epsilons.rumoca-ir-solve: Machine epsilons, scaled by the interval's time magnitude, that make up the roundoff of one accepted interval.

row_count.rumoca-phase-structural: Number of consecutive incidence rows the family occupies, from [`first_row`](Self::StructuredScalar::first_row).

rows.rumoca-ir-solve: Residual rows the projection plan solves.

runtime_assignment_roles.rumoca-ir-solve: Compiler certificate for whether each runtime assignment evaluates a relation (directly or through another runtime assignment).

runtime_targets.rumoca-ir-solve: Targets of the runtime assignments and of the post-commit assignments, in output order.

scalar.rumoca-phase-structural: Scalar selected from an aggregate expression; zero for scalar terms.

scalar_count.rumoca-ir-flat: Number of scalar equations this represents (MLS §8.4). For array equations like `x[n] = expr`, this is n. For scalar equations, this is 1. Used for balance checking per MLS §4.7.

scales.rumoca-ir-solve: The Newton scale of each unknown, aligned with `unknowns`.

scan_fraction.rumoca-ir-solve: Adjacent indicator samples are at most this fraction of the experiment width apart, independent of the output cadence (SPEC_0044 §6).

sccs_so_far.rumoca-phase-structural: Components closed so far, in the order they closed.

schedule.rumoca-ir-solve: The event iteration schedule the component walks (ME-EVENT-006).

scope.rumoca-ir-ast: Scope where the connect statement was declared (flattened prefix). Used to determine the correct hierarchy level for flow sum equations. Empty string means root level.
scope.rumoca-phase-structural: Which application of the quotient left the class unchanged.

scope_id.rumoca-ir-ast: Scope created by this class for name lookup. None when first parsed, populated during name resolution.

scope_to_class.rumoca-ir-ast: Each class scope's declaring class. Populated during resolve so later phases walk enclosing classes through the scope tree instead of re-parsing qualified names.

seed_rows.rumoca-ir-solve: The seed rows, whose targets [`projection_seed_rescue_targets`] restores when a seed is unavailable.

seeds.rumoca-ir-solve: Seed index of each slot over `[solver-y | parameter]`.

select.rumoca-phase-structural: `StateSelect` as declared, which decides whether the reduction is even allowed to consider demoting this member (MLS 3.6 §4.8.9).

sets.rumoca-ir-flat: All connection sets, indexed by a representative variable name.

shape.rumoca-ir-ast: Array dimensions - empty for scalars, e.g., [2, 3] for a 2x3 matrix Only populated when dimensions are known literal integers

shape_expr.rumoca-ir-ast: Raw array dimension subscripts (e.g., `n` in `Real x[n]` or `:` in `Real a[:]`) Used for parameter-dependent dimensions that need runtime evaluation Can be Subscript::Expression for explicit dimensions or Subscript::Range for `:`

shape_is_modification.rumoca-ir-ast: True if shape is from a modification (shape=x), false if from subscript \[x\]

sites.rumoca-ir-solve: Static `Call` operations in the caller's body, regions included.

sliding.rumoca-ir-solve: Whether a domain change of each indicator in the current interval applies without refinement.

sliding_gap_fraction.rumoca-ir-solve: The widest gap between two state events of one indicator, as a fraction of the scan resolution, that continues its streak.

sliding_streak.rumoca-ir-solve: Consecutive close state events of one indicator that make it slide ([`SlidingModes`]).

slots.rumoca-ir-solve: Unknown slots, projection unknowns first, then update targets.

solver_nominals.rumoca-ir-solve: Positive nominal values aligned with solver `y` slots.

solver_y.rumoca-ir-solve: An event writes a solver coordinate (a state reset or algebraic update).

source.rumoca-ir-ast: Optional source expression before eager resolution. When present, this preserves the symbolic modifier form (`k = parentK`) so downstream flat-output generation can keep parameter propagation relationships instead of hard-coding evaluated defaults.
source.rumoca-ir-solve: The step's tangent is `-b / a`: `b` the row's tangent with the target held, `a` the coefficient of the target, taken from the last lane, which seeds the target alone.
source.rumoca-phase-structural: The variable whose `fixed = true` start the value was read from.

source_is_discrete.rumoca-ir-solve: Whether the source uses piecewise-constant history rather than linear interpolation between accepted points.

source_location.rumoca-ir-ast: Source location of the component declaration that created this instance.

source_map.rumoca-ir-ast: Source map for mapping file names to SourceIds. Populated during session build for multi-file diagnostics.

source_modification_each_flags.rumoca-ir-ast: Parallel to `source_modifications` - true if the source modifier has an `each` prefix.

source_modification_final_flags.rumoca-ir-ast: Parallel to `source_modifications` - true if the source modifier has a `final` prefix.

source_modification_redeclare_flags.rumoca-ir-ast: Parallel to `source_modifications` - true if the source modifier is a redeclaration.

source_modifications.rumoca-ir-ast: Ordered source-form modifier arguments from the component declaration. These preserve the syntax inside `x(...)` before semantic component attributes are split into `start`, `binding`, `shape`, and `modifications`.

source_pins.rumoca-phase-structural: Exact initial-value transfers, indexed only in `source`.

source_rhs.rumoca-ir-solve: Current-value expressions whose accepted values populate history.

source_scalar.rumoca-phase-structural: Component of that declaration's initial equation, before transfer.

source_scope.rumoca-ir-ast: Optional lexical scope where the modifier expression was written. MLS §7.2.4: component modifications are evaluated in the scope where the modification appears, which may differ from the modified component's scope.

source_scope_id.rumoca-ir-ast: Resolved lexical scope of the class declaration that produced this instance.

source_span.rumoca-ir-flat: Source span for the `connect`, `Connections.branch`, or related graph-edge source.

source_starts.rumoca-ir-dae: Source ordinal each emitted record occupies; a model quotient owner record spans seven source ordinals, everything else one.

span.rumoca-ir-ast: Exact source range of the complete call, including delimiters.
span.rumoca-ir-flat: The selected if-equation, the declaration, or the for-equation.
span.rumoca-phase-structural: Producer source span for rejection diagnostics.

spans.rumoca-ir-solve: `(start, register count)` of each region in the source program.

stack.rumoca-phase-structural: Nodes currently on the Tarjan stack.

stalled.rumoca-phase-structural: Closest stalled intermediate, retained only when preparation fails.

start.rumoca-phase-structural: The `start` attribute as written, or `None` when the declaration omits it and takes the MLS 3.6 §4.8 Real default of zero.

start_has_each.rumoca-ir-ast: True if the start modifier has `each` prefix (for array components)

start_is_modification.rumoca-ir-ast: True if start value is from a modification (start=x), false if from binding (= x)

starts.rumoca-ir-solve: `starts[i]` is the first scalar ordinal of `runs[i]`.

state.rumoca-phase-structural: Whether each variable ordinal is declared a continuous state.

state_coordinate.rumoca-ir-solve: For a scalar of a generated state that a reduced state selection integrates, the source scalar it equals; `None` for every other visible scalar, each of which is its own declaration.

state_coordinates.rumoca-phase-structural: The integrated aggregate state of a formal state candidate and the source scalar each of its scalars equals, naming variables of `view`; `None` for every system no formal selection finalized.

state_jacobian.rumoca-ir-solve: The state Jacobian `d(der)/d(states)`, derived from `derivative` through the algebraic projection ([`StructuralPattern::derive_state_jacobian`]).

state_reinitializations.rumoca-ir-solve: Per published declaration: whether a source event may reset its state.

statements.rumoca-ir-flat: The statements in this algorithm section.

status_bindings.rumoca-ir-solve: Each function owner's status channels, in owner order.

step.rumoca-phase-structural: The replacement DAE and its manifold expressions, if one matched.

stored.rumoca-ir-solve: Slots stored so far and the register holding each.

streak.rumoca-ir-solve: Consecutive close state events of each indicator, ending at `last_event`.

structural.rumoca-ir-solve: Constructor-derived metadata; canonical Solve replay reconstructs it.
structural.rumoca-phase-structural: Structural matching and BLT analysis issued while this exact finalized DAE was admitted by structural preparation.

structured_equations.rumoca-ir-flat: Structured source equation families for regular equations.

structured_jacobian_v.rumoca-ir-solve: Row-aligned with the scalar view of [`DiscreteSolveSystem::structured_rhs`].

structured_rhs.rumoca-ir-solve: Compact B.1c maps. Scalar owners remain in `rhs`; a structured owner is represented exactly once here and is scalarized only by evaluation or backend adapter APIs.

sub_partition_index.rumoca-ir-flat: Dense-position lookup for unique sub-clock IDs.

sub_partitions.rumoca-ir-flat: Sub-clock partitions within this base partition.

sub_variable_owners.rumoca-ir-flat: Variable occurrence and owning sub-clock ID.

synchronize.rumoca-ir-ast: Whether to synchronize with sub-state machines of the target state. Default: false

synthesized_inner_messages.rumoca-ir-ast: Diagnostic messages attached to synthesized inner classes (MLS §5.4). Populated from each synthesized class's `missingInnerMessage` annotation when present, so the synthesized-inner warning can surface the class author's own guidance instead of a generic notice.

synthesized_inners.rumoca-ir-ast: Names of inner declarations synthesized during instantiation retry (MLS §5.4). Populated when `outer` components had no matching `inner` and automatic synthesis succeeded.

tangent_lanes.rumoca-ir-solve: Admit tensor operations of up to [`MAX_TENSOR_LANES`] interleaved lanes (a tangent-lane program) rather than one primal or two dual lanes.

targets.rumoca-phase-structural: Complete target tuple (DAE variable identities written by the producer).

tear_var_local_indices.rumoca-phase-structural: Indices of tear (iteration) variables within the block's unknown list.

tear_vars.rumoca-phase-structural: Tear (iteration) variable names — the nonlinear solve dimension.

tear_y_indices.rumoca-ir-solve: Solver-Y indices iterated by the reduced Newton. A subset of the block's `y_indices`, equal in count to `residual_rows`.

tearing.rumoca-ir-solve: Structural tearing of this coupled block. When present, the runtime projection iterates Newton only over the tear variables and recovers the remaining unknowns by ordered back-substitution, in the sense of Elmqvist and Otter, ESM'94, and Cellier and Kofman, "Continuous System Simulation", chapter 7. OpenModelica causalizes the same loops the same way, which makes it a behavioural cross-reference rather than the authority for the method. Absence selects the dense block Newton over every unknown.
tearing.rumoca-phase-structural: Greedy tearing of the loop, when one reduces the solve dimension. Local indices address `equations` and `unknowns` by position.

tears_so_far.rumoca-phase-structural: Tear variables chosen so far in this pass, in order.

template.rumoca-ir-flat: The family's canonical comprehension body, captured by flatten before the loop is expanded. When present, downstream phases read the template directly (printing it as a `for`-comprehension, deriving strides, building a compact kernel) instead of reconstructing it from materialized corner cells. `None` for families flattened before this representation existed. See [`rumoca_core::ComprehensionTemplate`].

terminal_event_parameter_index.rumoca-ir-solve: P-slot that is true only while applying the final simulation event.

terms.rumoca-ir-solve: Term of every register the segment wrote.

tested.rumoca-phase-structural: Every variable a recording map compared its target against; see [`AffineMap::recording`].

text_start.rumoca-ir-solve: The literal start of each scalar of a `String` declaration.

time_events.rumoca-ir-solve: The time events the component announces and stops at.

top_level_connectors.rumoca-ir-flat: Names of public top-level components whose class type is `connector` (MLS §4.7). Per MLS §4.7, only flow variables in top-level public connector components count toward the local equation size for balance checking. Components of type `model` or `block` (like Delta in transformers) are NOT interface connectors even if they contain connectors internally.

top_level_input_components.rumoca-ir-flat: Names of public top-level components declared with `input` causality. Fields of these components (e.g., `state.phase` from `input Record state`) are external inputs and should NOT be promoted to algebraic unknowns, unlike sub-component inputs from type interfaces (MLS §4.4.2.2).

top_level_output_components.rumoca-ir-flat: Public top-level components declared with `output` causality. Their record fields inherit the public interface prefix under MLS §4.4.2.2, independently of their runtime role (SPEC_0040 DAE-C24).

trial_rcond.rumoca-phase-structural: Reciprocal conditioning of this chart's dependent Jacobian at the construction trial point, and the singular threshold it is measured against. The mirror of a folding coordinate may sit at or below the threshold here because it is regular at a different configuration.

twice.rumoca-phase-structural: `twice(u) = scale(scale(u))`: a Modelica body over a pure callee.

type_def_id.rumoca-ir-ast: DefId of the component's type class (e.g., for `RealInput u`, this is the DefId of RealInput). None for built-in types (Real, Integer, Boolean, String). Populated during name resolution, used by instantiate phase for O(1) type lookup.

type_id.rumoca-ir-ast: Type of this component, resolved during type checking. None when first parsed, populated during type checking.
type_id.rumoca-ir-flat: Reference to the type in the TypeTable.

type_ids_by_def_id.rumoca-ir-ast: Exact nominal type identity keyed by resolved source declaration identity. This is producer-owned transition evidence from post-instantiation typechecking. Flattening uses it to type function values without interpreting their display names.
