SolveLayout.initial_homotopy_parameter_index: Hidden P-slot used by initialization residuals that contain `homotopy(actual, simplified)`. The initialization driver advances this value from zero to one. Models without homotopy expressions omit the slot entirely.
SolveLayout.input_scalar_names: One name and shape per input declaration; scalar names are derived.
SolveLayout.pre_param_bindings: Snapshot bindings for `__pre__.*` parameters created by DAE-IR pre_lowering. At event entry the runtime copies each source slot into the corresponding dest P-slot before the event equations evaluate.
SolveLayout.terminal_event_parameter_index: P-slot that is true only while applying the final simulation event.
SolveLayout.variable_declarations: Canonical typed DAE declarations in the same dense identity order.
SolveLayout.variable_storage_runs: Dense DAE variable ordinal to its first Solve storage slot. Scalar `k` of a variable is stored at `base + k` in the same column. This is the canonical cross-phase coordinate map; display names are not used to recover compiler identity.

SolveLiveness.dead: Operations that are neither planned nor emitted; empty when none is.
SolveLiveness.dropped: Output slots whose stores are dead; empty when none is.
SolveLiveness.loaded: Slots some running operation loads; empty when every slot is.
SolveLiveness.unused_captures: The captures of each running conditional that neither arm loads, by operation.

SolveModel.pure_calls: Exact pure DAE call frames shared by value, root, action, and visible projections. Empty minimal fixtures still carry the canonical binary64 arithmetic profile; lowering never reconstructs this table from rows.
SolveModel.solver_nominals: Positive nominal values aligned with solver `y` slots.

SolveOperation.continuation: An early-exit predicate over the carried tuple, the captures and the binder values of the pass about to run, evaluated before each pass; the first false value ends the loop with the current tuple (MLS §11.2.3). The producer proves that every skipped pass would leave the tuple unchanged, so the domain stays the static capacity while a run-time bound such as `i <= n` decides how many passes execute.
SolveOperation.indices: Scalar Integer registers containing one-based Modelica coordinates.

SolveScalarNames.starts: `starts[i]` is the first scalar ordinal of `runs[i]`.

SolveVariableMeta.phasor: For a scalar whose defining equation makes it the angle of a phasor, or the cosine of that angle, the phasor's component scalars; `None` for every other visible scalar.
SolveVariableMeta.state_coordinate: For a scalar of a generated state that a reduced state selection integrates, the source scalar it equals; `None` for every other visible scalar, each of which is its own declaration.

StagedRefreshStep.seed_rows: The seed rows, whose targets [`projection_seed_rescue_targets`] restores when a seed is unavailable.

Substitution.composed: Composed coordinates per (access, source), `None` when whole.
Substitution.finished: Finished outputs per (summary, output type), while no argument has been reassigned.

Taint.exact: Registers that hold exactly a chosen parameter or a constant.
Taint.poisoned_from: Every register at or above this one is unknown (a compact op whose extent is not enumerable).

Term.output_lane: None means every output lane; otherwise only this output lane.

Terms.next: The first term no value or slot owns yet.

TimeEvents.clocks: The periodic clocks, in clock-owner order.
TimeEvents.instants: Static instants of `when time >= c` events and discontinuous time relations (the problem's scheduled time events).
TimeEvents.match_tolerance: The relative tolerance within which two instants are one instant (`SCHEDULE_TIME_RELATIVE_TOLERANCE`).

TornTangentPlan.programs: Multi-lane programs; empty when the plan evaluates one direction at a time through the JVP programs.

TornTangentResidual.group: Rows answered by one evaluation of this row's program, counting itself; zero when an earlier row's evaluation answers it.

TornTangentStep.group: Steps answered by one evaluation of this step's program, counting itself; zero when an earlier step's evaluation answers it.
TornTangentStep.reached: Tear columns whose tangents reach the step through the rows it reads.
TornTangentStep.source: The step's tangent is `-b / a`: `b` the row's tangent with the target held, `a` the coefficient of the target, taken from the last lane, which seeds the target alone.

TypedProgramBuilder.numbered_values: Whether repeated scalar computations share a register; a replayed wire keeps every recorded register.

UnlocalizableGuard.unknown_names: The block's unknowns by name, as the warning states them.
UnlocalizableGuard.y_indices: Solver-Y indices of the block's unknowns.

ValueKey.width: The number of outputs the key was issued with.

AffineMap.tested: Every variable a recording map compared its target against; see [`AffineMap::recording`].

AliasClassReport.retained_states: Other states of the class, which keep their role and edge equation.

AssertedEquality.displaced: Whether the two variables are separated by a displacement the residual does not prove zero. A displaced pair still shares a derivative; it does not share a value.

BlockReport.equations_per_point: Scalar equations emitted per domain point.
BlockReport.first_row: First incidence row the family occupies. Published because the compact form names no individual equation, so a consumer checking that the blocks **partition** the equations has no other way to learn which rows this block accounts for. `origin` is a description and the two counts are a size; neither locates the family in the incidence.
BlockReport.point_count: Number of domain points the family covers.
BlockReport.row_count: Number of consecutive incidence rows the family occupies, from [`first_row`](Self::StructuredScalar::first_row).
BlockReport.tearing: Tearing of the block, when one could be computed.
BlockReport.unknowns: Unknown names coupled in the block.

BltBlock.tearing: Greedy tearing of the loop, when one reduces the solve dimension. Local indices address `equations` and `unknowns` by position.

ClockCoincidence.coincident_pairs: Cross-identity pairs proved coincident, stored as `(low, high)`.

CoordinateAccess.value_type: Structural value type (scalar kind and shape); declared quantity and unit types may differ across an equation, which already equates them.

DemotionPassPolicy.reuse: The prior round's incidence, reused for owners this demotion leaves untouched; `None` disables reuse and rebuilds the incidence in full.

DemotionRound.blocked: Only ever set when `step` is `None`: a stated initial value that the only demotions left would have discarded. That refusal is the reason the system stops reducing here, so it is what the phase reports rather than the singularity it hides behind.
DemotionRound.step: The demotion this round took, if any.

DemotionRowBounds.variable_columns: The unknown columns of each state and algebraic variable, in the dense variable order the incidence catalog uses (a state's columns are its derivative scalars, an algebraic's its value scalars); `None` for a variable with no unknown columns.
DemotionRowBounds.variable_owners: Continuous owners that reference each variable in any coordinate form, in ascending owner order. A direct-state demotion rewrites exactly the owners that mention the demoted variable, so this is the set of rows the incremental incidence reprojects; every other row is reused unchanged.

DemotionScreen.base_matching: A maximum matching of the base rows, built on the first bound.

DemotionStep.reusable: The incidence of the reduced system, carried to the next round so it reuses the rows this demotion did not touch.

DerivativeClosure.pending: Expressions whose derivative is still to be followed.
DerivativeClosure.rates: Explicit derivative definitions, read as values.

DifferentialStructure.invariant_columns: Columns whose coordinate is a parameter-constant algebraic. Their offset is pinned to zero and their derivatives are always available as the zero constant, so a differentiated equation that reads one never raises its order.

ExpressionRebuilder.inline_calls: STRUCT-T10(b): source call nodes replaced by their substituted body.
ExpressionRebuilder.literal_expressions: SPEC_0043 §4: source expressions replaced by their literal values.

FormalDerivativeView.source_pins: Exact initial-value transfers, indexed only in `source`.

FunctionRebuilder.literals: Literal values that replace constant expressions of function bodies.

Functions.impure_external: `external "C" y = ext(u)` without explicit purity: MLS §12.3 treats it as impure.
Functions.twice: `twice(u) = scale(scale(u))`: a Modelica body over a pure callee.
Functions.wrap: `wrap(u) = ext(u)`: a Modelica body that reaches an impure callee.

HolonomicReductionState.reusable: The incidence of the current system while its manifold is empty, so a direct round reuses untouched rows and screens candidates exactly as the outer direct lane does.

HolonomicRound.blocked: A stated initial value the matching reductions would have discarded.
HolonomicRound.step: The replacement DAE and its manifold expressions, if one matched.

Incidence.owner_first_row: First scalar row of each continuous owner, terminated by `n_eq`, so owner `i` occupies rows `owner_first_row[i]..owner_first_row[i + 1]`. This lets the incremental reduction copy an untouched owner's rows verbatim from a prior round.

IncidenceBuilder.occurrences: The unknown occurrences of the row being projected, reused across rows.

InitialValuePin.coordinate: The coordinate the retained equation is stated about. Definitions and state checks name a state; direct checks name their algebraic/output.
InitialValuePin.role: How the runtime must enforce it.
InitialValuePin.scalar: Scalar selected from an aggregate coordinate; zero for scalar pins.
InitialValuePin.source: The variable whose `fixed = true` start the value was read from.
InitialValuePin.source_scalar: Component of that declaration's initial equation, before transfer.
InitialValuePin.value: Signed terms whose sum is the stated value.

ManifoldConstraint.redundant: Whether this row belongs to a redundant loop-closure constraint. A conserved first integral (its lower-order form is implied by the ODE, so one differentiation already reconstructs a matched state derivative) is definitional and keeps `false`; a genuine loop closure, whose position form is over-determining and is closed only by differentiating to acceleration through a multiplier, is redundant and carries `true`.

MemberFacts.avoided: `StateSelect.avoid` or `never`: a state the model prefers not to keep.
MemberFacts.formal: A generated index-reduction declaration: a formal-derivative coordinate.

PinTerm.scalar: Scalar selected from an aggregate expression; zero for scalar terms.

PinnedMember.at_root: The value the pin states for the class root.
PinnedMember.variable: Closure identity, including a component when the source is projected.

PreferredAdmission.raised_owners: `(first canonical row, order before this admission)` per raised owner.

PreparedDae.manifold_redundant: Redundancy classification parallel to `manifold`: `true` marks a row of a loop-closure constraint that must reduce, `false` a conserved first integral that may be retained.
PreparedDae.reduced: The integrated state map and admissible reduced charts issued by the formal-derivative selection. Empty except on the reduced-selection path that finalizes a formal state candidate.

PreparedReducedChart.trial_rcond: Reciprocal conditioning of this chart's dependent Jacobian at the construction trial point, and the singular threshold it is measured against. The mirror of a folding coordinate may sit at or below the threshold here because it is regular at a different configuration.

PreparedSystem.charts: Admissible reduced state-selection charts for a folding definitional first-integral coordinate group, naming scalars of `view`. Empty for every prepared system without such a group.
PreparedSystem.manifold: Constraint expressions an index reduction left on the state manifold.
PreparedSystem.pins: MLS 3.6 §8.6 initial equations rewritten onto the state each one determines. The proof that decides which stated value defines a state and which one only restates it lives in this phase's `initial_pins` module, which is private — naming it as a doc link would make the public page point at an item its reader cannot open.
PreparedSystem.state_coordinates: The integrated aggregate state of a formal state candidate and the source scalar each of its scalars equals, naming variables of `view`; `None` for every system no formal selection finalized.
PreparedSystem.structural: Structural matching and BLT analysis issued while this exact finalized DAE was admitted by structural preparation.

RebuildRequest.inert_states: STRUCT-T04: states declared algebraic whose derivative reads rebuild as zero.

ReductionEvent.scope: Which application of the quotient left the class unchanged.

ReductionReport.stalled: Closest stalled intermediate, retained only when preparation fails.

ResidualRelevance.by_variable: Residual ordinals by the variables their walks compared against.
ResidualRelevance.unconditional: Residuals whose recording walk already yields a row, relevant to every variable.

Resolved.negated: Whether the variable is the negation of the root's value.
Resolved.offset: The displacement between the variable and the (signed) root value.

SameTickDefinitions.refresh_on_tick: Exact always-active discrete definitions must execute inside a clock partition when one of its producers reads them. Their stored entry value predates the tick, even when they do not depend on another clock-owned producer (for example `fresh = valid and sample(...)`).

SameTickProducer.clock_domains: Canonical periodic-clock domains on which this producer can execute. Same-tick exchange exists only between producers whose domains can fire on one shared instant under the caller's [`ClockCoincidence`] relation (identical domains always do); a never-coincident read observes held entry storage.
SameTickProducer.condition_reads: Condition roots (guards/triggers) evaluated at the tick.
SameTickProducer.read_context: Construction-issued current/entry facts, or the synchronous boundary.
SameTickProducer.span: Producer source span for rejection diagnostics.
SameTickProducer.targets: Complete target tuple (DAE variable identities written by the producer).
SameTickProducer.value_reads: Value expression roots evaluated at the tick.

SameTickSchedule.intermediate_consumers: Consumer producer indices for every issued intermediate variable. This is derived by the same dependency walk that issued `steps`. Solve lowering maps the consumers to their typed clock domains once; a runtime must not rediscover this liveness from programs or storage.

SameTickStep.read_boundary: This row refreshes an ordinary event value, not an MLS16 history view.

SelectedCoordinate.origin: The formal value coordinate of the source declaration at order zero, of which `value` is the `order`-th formal derivative.

SignedClasses.anchor: Anchor of the class rooted at each variable ordinal.
SignedClasses.anchor_parity: Sign of the member that supplied an invariant anchor relative to its class root. Derivative readers deliberately ignore this sign because both signs differentiate to zero; value readers must retain it.
SignedClasses.inconsistent: Classes whose edges contradict each other and prove nothing usable.
SignedClasses.parity: Sign of each variable relative to its union-find parent.
SignedClasses.rank: Union-by-rank bound on parent depth; ties keep the lower root. Variable identities are `u32`, so the rank cannot exceed 32.

StateDeclaration.pinned: Whether the model pins that start with `fixed = true`.
StateDeclaration.start: The `start` attribute as written, or `None` for the Real default.

StatedInitialValue.select: `StateSelect` as declared, which decides whether the reduction is even allowed to consider demoting this member (MLS 3.6 §4.8.9).
StatedInitialValue.start: The `start` attribute as written, or `None` when the declaration omits it and takes the MLS 3.6 §4.8 Real default of zero.

StructuralEvent.causal_so_far: Equations solved causally so far in this pass, as `(equation, variable)`.
StructuralEvent.match_eq: The matching as of this instant: `match_eq[i] = Some(j)` means equation `i` owns variable `j`.
StructuralEvent.sccs_so_far: Components closed so far, in the order they closed.
StructuralEvent.stack: Nodes currently on the Tarjan stack.
StructuralEvent.tears_so_far: Tear variables chosen so far in this pass, in order.

StructuralReport.aliases: The STRUCT-T02 alias quotient applied before this analysis, including every class it left unchanged and why.
StructuralReport.formal_aliases: The second, formal-derivative application of the quotient on the reduced candidate Solve lowering executes, when one exists.
StructuralReport.matching: Maximum matching as `(equation, unknown)` pairs — which equation determines which variable.
StructuralReport.n_equations: Number of equations in the analyzed system.
StructuralReport.n_unknowns: Number of unknowns in the analyzed system.
StructuralReport.notes: Scope notes a reader needs to interpret this analysis, such as a reduced state selection that executes a different system.

StructuredSeedOutcome.fully_seeded_ranges: Row ranges in which *every* row was seeded, ascending and disjoint. Kuhn never needs to look at these rows again.

SystemEqualities.affine: Classes proven equal up to sign and a time-invariant displacement. Members share a derivative but not necessarily a value.
SystemEqualities.coordinate: Whole-model coordinate views naming each state payload.
SystemEqualities.exact: Classes proven equal up to sign, with no displacement between members. Answers every question about a value.
SystemEqualities.state: Whether each variable ordinal is declared a continuous state.
SystemEqualities.witness: One asserted equality incident to each variable, for candidate owners.

TearingReport.causal_sequence: Causal solve order: `(equation, variable)` pairs solved in sequence once the tear variables are known.
TearingReport.residual_equations: Residual equation labels, one per tear variable.
TearingReport.tear_vars: Tear (iteration) variable names — the nonlinear solve dimension.

TearingResult.causal_sequence: Causal steps: (equation local index, variable local index) in solve order.
TearingResult.residual_eq_local_indices: Indices of residual equations within the block's equation list. Same count as `tear_var_local_indices`.
TearingResult.tear_var_local_indices: Indices of tear (iteration) variables within the block's unknown list.

UnlocalizableGuard.unknown_names: The block's unknowns by name, the first few and a count of the rest.

ValueClosure.contradicted: Per root: classes whose recorded equalities contradict each other, which prove nothing a transfer may stand on.
ValueClosure.invariant: Per root: the constant value the system proves the root holds.
ValueClosure.offset: Displacement of each variable from its (signed) parent value.
ValueClosure.parent: Union-find parent per whole variable or authored component identity.
ValueClosure.parity: Whether each variable is the negation of its parent's value.
